Read input: origen_085121.v · Open raw
module origen_085121 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire mem,
    input wire rw,
    input wire [17:0] addr,
    input wire [15:0] data_f2s,
    output reg ready,
    output reg [15:0] data_s2f_r,
    output wire [15:0] data_s2f_ur,
    output reg [17:0] ad,
    output reg we_n,
    output reg oe_n,
    output wire ce_a_n,
    output wire ub_a_n,
    output wire lb_a_n,
    inout wire [15:0] dio_a
);

    // State encoding
    localparam IDLE = 3'd0, RD1 = 3'd1, RD2 = 3'd2, WR1 = 3'd3, WR2 = 3'd4;
    reg [2:0] state, next_state;

    // Internal registers
    reg [15:0] data_f2s_reg;
    reg dio_oe;

    // State machine
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset)
            state <= IDLE;
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    // Next state logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: next_state = mem ? (rw ? WR1 : RD1) : IDLE;
            RD1:  next_state = RD2;
            RD2:  next_state = IDLE;
            WR1:  next_state = WR2;
            WR2:  next_state = IDLE;
            default: next_state = IDLE;
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            ready <= 1'b1;
            we_n <= 1'b1;
            oe_n <= 1'b1;
            ad <= 18'd0;
            data_s2f_r <= 16'd0;
            data_f2s_reg <= 16'd0;
            dio_oe <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    ready <= 1'b1;
                    we_n <= 1'b1;
                    oe_n <= 1'b1;
                    dio_oe <= 1'b0;
                    if (mem) begin
                        ad <= addr;
                        data_f2s_reg <= data_f2s;
                        ready <= 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                RD1: begin
                    oe_n <= 1'b0;
                    ready <= 1'b0;
                end
                RD2: begin
                    data_s2f_r <= dio_a;
                    oe_n <= 1'b1;
                end
                WR1: begin
                    we_n <= 1'b0;
                    dio_oe <= 1'b1;
                    ready <= 1'b0;
                end
                WR2: begin
                    we_n <= 1'b1;
                    dio_oe <= 1'b1;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    // Continuous assignments
    assign ce_a_n = 1'b0;
    assign ub_a_n = 1'b0;
    assign lb_a_n = 1'b0;
    assign data_s2f_ur = dio_a;
    assign dio_a = dio_oe ? data_f2s_reg : 16'bz;

endmodule
